title: Summit Purchased Miles Price List
content:
Award miles bought in the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program are sold in fixed increments with a smallest purchase and an annual limit. The price list is the same at every tier.

| Tier | Purchase must be a whole multiple of (miles) | Smallest purchase (miles) | Price per 1000 miles (USD) | Most miles bought in one calendar year |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Summit Member | 1000 | 2000 | 35 | 150000 |
| Summit Silver | 1000 | 2000 | 35 | 150000 |
| Summit Gold | 1000 | 2000 | 35 | 150000 |
| Summit Platinum | 1000 | 2000 | 35 | 150000 |
| Summit Diamond | 1000 | 2000 | 35 | 150000 |
| Summit Chairman | 1000 | 2000 | 35 | 150000 |

**Reading the list (hypothetical quantities)**

- 1000 miles is a whole multiple of the increment but below the smallest purchase of 2000 miles.
- 2000 miles meets both; 2500 miles is above the smallest purchase but is not a whole multiple of 1000 miles.
- At the listed price, 4000 miles are four thousands at 35 USD, 140 USD.
